author: Cleo Abram
description:
This guy was banned from the Olympics even though he had the fifth fastest time in the world…. 

He was using running blades but by itself that’s not illegal!

The big question was, did he have a CORRECTION or an ENHANCEMENT…

Do you agree with the decision? Tell me in the comments and subscribe!

title: He Was Banned From The Olympics for Being Too Tall
